title: Tirzepatide once weekly for the treatment of obesity
authors: Jastreboff AM, Aronne LJ, Ahmad NN, Wharton S, Connery L, Alves B, et al.
population: Adults without diabetes with BMI of 30 or more, or 27 or more with a weight-related complication; mean weight 104.8 kg, mean BMI 38.0
funder: Supported by Eli Lilly, as stated in the abstract; the sponsor's role was not read.
result: Mean weight change at week 72 was -15.0% (95% CI -15.9 to -14.2) on tirzepatide 5 mg, -19.5% (-20.4 to -18.5) on 10 mg and -20.9% (-21.8 to -19.9) on 15 mg against -3.1% (-4.3 to -1.9) on placebo. Weight reduction of 20% or more in 50% and 57% on 10 and 15 mg against 3%. Adverse events caused discontinuation in 4.3%, 7.1% and 6.2% against 2.6%; the most common adverse events were gastrointestinal.
